promote.home.sub.en: Prepare ads, choose and approve them, approve the budget, launch, then review results.
promote.home.sub.zh: 准备广告，选择并批准广告，批准预算，投放，再查看结果。

promote.home.emptyTitle.en: Your first campaign starts with a drama
promote.home.emptyTitle.zh: 从一部剧开始第一个广告活动

promote.home.emptyHint.en: Choose an uploaded title to prepare direct-clip and creator-style ads.
promote.home.emptyHint.zh: 选择已上传的作品，准备直剪和达人风格广告。

promote.new.sub.en: A campaign is one round of ads for a single drama. Save the brief first, then generate and select ads, approve the content and budget, and submit the round.
promote.new.sub.zh: 一个广告活动是针对一部剧集的一轮广告测试。先保存简报，再生成并选择广告，批准内容与预算后提交。

promote.new.noTitlesHint.en: Add a title to your catalog, then return here to plan its ads. You can upload video later.
promote.new.noTitlesHint.zh: 先将短剧加入剧库，再回来规划广告。视频可稍后上传。

promote.new.videoRequired.en: This title needs at least one episode video before ad generation can begin.
promote.new.videoRequired.zh: 这部剧至少需要一集视频，才能开始生成广告。

promote.new.directionHint.en: For example: she looks powerless at first, but the audience should sense she is in control.
promote.new.directionHint.zh: 例如：她一开始看似弱势，但观众应能察觉她掌控全局。

promote.new.exclusionsHint.en: Characters, episodes, plot reveals, claims, or visual moments to avoid.
promote.new.exclusionsHint.zh: 需要避开的角色、剧集、剧透、表述或画面。

promote.new.spoilerHint.en: This controls which moments can become hooks—not just the copy.
promote.new.spoilerHint.zh: 这决定哪些剧情能用作开头钩子，不只是文案。

promote.new.outputHint.en: Saving creates a draft. On the next screen, generate five ad proposals with opening lines, captions and source clips, then choose which to test.
promote.new.outputHint.zh: 保存后创建草稿。下一步可生成五条广告方案，包含开场文案、配文和源片段，再选择要测试的广告。

promote.workspace.sub.en: Review the hypothesis behind each ad—not just whether the clip looks good.
promote.workspace.sub.zh: 审阅每条广告背后的获客假设，而不只是画面是否好看。

promote.workspace.readyHint.en: Generate five ads from the uploaded episode videos, then choose the ads for your first test. Review results before preparing another round.
promote.workspace.readyHint.zh: 根据已上传的分集视频生成 5 条广告，选择首轮测试的广告，查看结果后再准备下一轮。

promote.new.pickHint.en: Ads are generated from this drama's episodes.
promote.new.pickHint.zh: 广告将根据该剧的剧集生成。

promote.workspace.roundNote.en: Generate 5 ads, choose which to test, then review results before the next round.
promote.workspace.roundNote.zh: 生成 5 条广告，选择测试广告，查看结果后再开始下一轮。

promote.workspace.revised.zh: Pulsar 已修改 · 第 {v} 版

promote.workspace.changeSent.zh: 已提交修改要求，等待 Pulsar 审核

promote.new.requirements.en: Enter a campaign name, a destination link, an audience (at least 3 characters), and a test idea (at least 10 characters) to save.
promote.new.requirements.zh: 填写活动名称、去向链接、目标受众（至少 3 个字符）和测试想法（至少 10 个字符）后保存。

promote.new.someNoVideo.en: Titles without video can still save a US campaign brief; generating video ads needs footage.
promote.new.someNoVideo.zh: 暂无视频的剧集也可保存美国活动简报；生成视频广告需要素材。
